user.title: WHU Electricity Meter
user.description: Enter the web root address of the electricity/water platform (the part before '#' in the URL you open on your phone).

confirm_real_server.title: Confirm external server
confirm_real_server.description:
The address you entered is treated as an **external / production server**:

{base_url}

If you continue, the integration will **immediately send real requests to this server** (sign in, then walk down the area / building / floor / room / meter lists). Every request is throttled to at most one per second, but they are real traffic initiated by you and will be recorded by that server.

· Local debugging only: close this dialog and go back to use a loopback or LAN address (for example http://host.docker.internal:8899).
· Connect to this server: tick the option below, then submit.

data.confirm_real_server: I understand this is an external / production server and consent to real requests

meter.title: Select meter
meter.description: Multiple meters were found in this room. Choose the one to add.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the electricity/water platform. Check the address (it must match the root address you use on your phone).
error.no_meter: No meter was found in this room. Go back and choose again.
error.rate_limited: To protect the platform server, the integration limits requests to at most one per second. You clicked too fast: please wait 1-2 seconds and retry.
error.confirm_required: Not confirmed, so no request was sent to this address. Tick the confirmation box and submit; or switch to a loopback/LAN address if you only need local debugging.

init.title: Fetching and alerts
init.description: When enabled, the integration creates and maintains a "low balance email alert" automation in automations.yaml, sending an HTML warning email through the selected SMTP notify service when the balance drops below the threshold.

data.email_alert_enabled: Low balance email alert (auto-creates the automation)
data.email_notify_entity: SMTP notify entity (configure the email notify integration first)
